facts.fact: Article 7 of Loi n°025/2023 creates the Autorité pour la Protection des Données Personnelles et de la Vie Privée (APDPVP) as an independent administrative authority, with powers to authorise processing, receive complaints, and issue warnings, formal notices, suspensions and fines of CFA 1 million to 100 million (arts. 199-204); the text names no appointment of its members.
